description: QuotesTab reads the source business template id from the quotes-tab URL query.
QuoteFormProps.initialContext carries a sourceTemplateId field.
QuotesTab passes the source template id into QuoteForm through initialContext.
The Quote Templates row action "Create Quote from Template" emits the renamed sourceTemplateId query param.
QuoteForm seeds its source-template state from initialContext once the business template list has loaded.
Deep-link seeding reuses the picker's existing prefill routine rather than duplicating the field-copy logic.
Deep-link seeding applies exactly once per mount and does not re-apply on subsequent renders.
Deep-linked create prefills terms and conditions from the template.
Deep-linked create prefills client notes, description, PO number and currency from the template.
Deep-linked create prefills the template's line items.
Template prefill is non-destructive: values already seeded from an opportunity context are preserved.
Submitting a deep-linked create routes through createQuoteFromTemplate instead of createQuote.
Line items are not persisted client-side when the server already created them from the template.
A deep link naming a missing or inaccessible template degrades to a blank new quote without crashing.
The QuoteForm state field template_id is renamed to source_template_id, meaning create-time provenance only.
Edit mode no longer loads the layout id into the source-template field; the field stays empty when editing.
documentTemplateId remains the sole carrier of the layout id and is what is written back to quotes.template_id.
The "+ From template" picker binds to the renamed source-template field.
The title-required guard keys off the renamed source-template field, so a layout alone no longer satisfies it.
The layout deep link ?tab=quote-templates&templateId= is left unchanged.
coveredBy: No new test: this is a no-change assertion already guarded by the existing QuoteDocumentTemplateEditor suites.

description: AST text nodes preserve newlines when rendered.
An explicit whiteSpace set in a text node's own style still overrides the preserve-newlines default.
Multi-paragraph terms and conditions render with paragraph breaks intact in the generated quote PDF.
coveredBy: Smoke test (end-to-end PDF download). T009 covers the renderer unit underneath it.
